instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Mid-scale restaurant chain with 12 locations serving Mediterranean cuisine. Central kitchen produces 70% of menu items for distribution to satellite locations. Evaluating kitchen display systems, AI-driven prep quantity forecasting, and centralized procurement optimization. Currently operating from a single location with very limited management layers. Decision-making is fast and informal, but we lack the specialized expertise in-house to evaluate complex technology investments without external advisory support.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm. We run quarterly hackathons, maintain a formal patent portfolio, and have a rotating 'innovation fellow' program where high-potential employees spend 6 months dedicated to exploratory projects. Our last hackathon produced a prototype for automated quality inspection using computer vision that is now in production, reducing defect escape rate by 35%.
answers.strategicGoals: Our core business is stable and cash-generative, but we see limited growth potential within our current market. We are actively exploring adjacent business models — potentially a marketplace, a subscription-based service layer, or a data monetization play built on the proprietary data we already collect. We are willing to incubate 2-3 experimental business lines with seed funding to test viability.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

input.changes_since_last: Acquired 6 new enterprise clients. Expanded into adjacent market. Digital maturity improving.

opportunities.title: Establish Data Monetization Platform for Adjacent Markets
opportunities.rationale: Leverage the proprietary operational and customer data collected from current 12 locations to identify scalable data products. This directly addresses the strategic goal of exploring a data monetization play.

first_actions: Define required data sets for commercial viability (e.g., procurement patterns, menu popularity).
Pilot a lightweight data aggregation pipeline using existing infrastructure.
Establish legal/compliance framework for data usage related to high regulatory environment.
resources_needed: Legal Counsel consultation on data monetization contracts
Budget allocation: 3% of new budget increase
execution_plan.success_metric: Generate first revenue stream from a data product pilot within Q3.
milestones: Data pipeline operational and validated for security.
MVP Data Product defined and priced.

opportunities.title: **Launch Subscription-Based Service Layer (Marketplace)**
opportunities.rationale: To achieve diversification, build an experimental marketplace or subscription service that utilizes the adjacent market opportunities identified. This requires significant organizational restructuring and carries higher risk.

first_actions: Form a dedicated 'Incubation Team' (3-4 people) with clear ownership.
Conduct comprehensive feasibility study on legal, operational, and technological requirements for the marketplace model.
Secure seed funding specifically earmarked for this experimental line.
execution_plan.success_metric: Validate market demand and achieve 10 paying subscribers within the first year.
milestones: Formal business case approval for service layer.
Pilot launch in one adjacent geographic area.

next_steps.action: Approve and secure dedicated resource allocation for a hybrid 'Innovation/R&D' function, moving away from reactive development cycles.
Finalize the incubation strategy for the 2-3 experimental business lines identified, defining clear success metrics and exit criteria.
Develop a specific compliance roadmap addressing the high regulatory environment for new digital initiatives (opp 1 & 2).

key_weaknesses: Resource Allocation/Bandwidth: The reliance on generalist developers splitting time between maintenance and prototyping limits innovation velocity.
Decision-Making Bottleneck: Owner_alone decision-making creates a single point of failure and slows strategic pivots.
Execution Discipline: Transitioning from 'evaluation' (quarterly hackathons) to structured execution requires stronger operational rigor.

improvements: Successfully acquired 6 new enterprise clients, validating market reach.
Proof-of-concept prototype for automated quality inspection is now in production, demonstrating successful innovation integration into operations (35% defect reduction).
Digital maturity shows measurable improvement based on operational feedback and investment cycles.
persistent_gaps: Lack of dedicated expertise: Inability to evaluate complex technology investments without external advisory support.
Time constraint: Innovation relies too heavily on 'spare cycles' rather than structured time allocation, leading to inconsistency.
achieved_milestones: Prototype for automated quality inspection moved from hackathon to production.
Adjacent market expansion successful (6 new enterprise clients).

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Growth in enterprise clients and operational proof of concept success have validated the existing formal innovation process. The primary shift is moving from internal evaluation to active incubation/diversification planning.
